success_guarantee.condition: An earlier same-kind stage actually processed successfully. This does not assume whole-task success or saved/retrieved memory.
success_guarantee.scope: Deterministic feedback and stable assignments; structural checks do not simulate native agent learning.

candidate_order_budget.scope: Every compatible requested-type pair and both 24-order permutations; choose each type's instance by public route cost, inspect then process on match. Arbitrary wandering is not bounded.

type_count_review.scope: Same fixed scripted feedback policy, evaluator-compatible worlds. Determined from delivered evidence is not equivalent to saved or used by a native agent.
type_count_review.recommendation: Keep eight types for Easy mechanism validation; do not claim large-capacity memory or controlled interference. Add separate higher-cardinality conditions if that becomes a research target.

limits: No native agent or externally written memories.
Successful processing guarantees exposure, not saving or causal use.
Failed tasks retain only actual feedback; no forced catch-up.
Delays between requirements do not establish unrefreshed retention; negative cost effects do not establish interference.
